visual_asset_management_system.model: Entity → Atomic Master Asset → Derived Reference Sheet → Reference Resolver → Shot Reference Package → Generation → Product Owner Approval → Automatic Ingest → Asset Registry / Audit Trail

character_tiers.D: background or one-off / no full core set

visual_asset_management_system.orientation_rule: LEFT / RIGHT use screen-facing convention: face/nose toward screen-right = RIGHT; toward screen-left = LEFT
visual_asset_management_system.authority_lifecycle_resolver_rule: Authority defines what an asset can prove; Lifecycle defines version state; Resolver Usage defines whether/when production may call it.
visual_asset_management_system.single_current_rule: For the same entity_id + role + variant + state, or shot_id + role + variant + state, at most one formal Asset may have lifecycle=CURRENT. No separate default/latest/current_master fact layer is maintained.
visual_asset_management_system.archived_shot_rule: APPROVED locked A-Series shot assets may remain lifecycle=ARCHIVED and resolver_usage=CONDITIONAL for continuity / previous-shot / explicit-shot reference use.
visual_asset_management_system.scene_master_rule: Scene Master locks scene facts, not shot photography. Changes to locked scene facts require controlled Scene Variant / State.
visual_asset_management_system.derived_dependency_rule: If a DERIVED_REFERENCE upstream dependency becomes superseded/deprecated/invalid, compute DEPENDENCY_STALE; do not add it to Lifecycle and do not allow DEFAULT Resolver use until regenerated and approved.
visual_asset_management_system.normal_user_role: creative judgment, exception handling, formal approval; no routine manual reference picking/naming/storage/registration
required_capabilities: Scene / Costume / Prop / State / Variant specification
visual_asset_management_system.gate_validation: must migrate real existing Black Lady assets and validate automatic reference selection before READY_FOR_APPROVAL
visual_asset_management_system.character_format_rule: 9:16 vertical target; generator-native minor pixel rounding allowed; non-target aspect ratio fails Fixed Standard Review
visual_asset_management_system.character_review_rule: Generation → user sends 【审核】 → Fixed Standard Review → PASS / Targeted Revision
